criteria.name: Neural Forecasting Model Design
criteria.guidance: Build a suitable feed-forward or sequence neural model for forecasting and document architecture/settings.

criteria.name: Sequence Preparation & Training
criteria.guidance: Construct chronological sequences, scale using training data only, and prevent leakage across splits.

criteria.name: Forecast Evaluation & Overfitting Analysis
criteria.guidance: Evaluate on future holdout data, inspect training/validation behaviour and analyze forecast errors.

criteria.name: ML vs DL/Baseline Comparison
criteria.guidance: Compare deep learning, the best ML candidate and naive baselines on the same forecast horizon.

criteria.name: Forecasting Findings & Error Analysis
criteria.guidance: Interpret horizon, uncertainty and group-level performance; clearly distinguish forecast from actual sales.
